title: Downey Is Doom. What Should You Watch Before Doomsday?
description: Does Robert Downey Jr. playing Doctor Doom mean Tony Stark is back? Here is what Disney confirmed, what remains a theory, and one optional movie to understand Reed Richards and the Fantastic Four.
hook: Downey is back for Doomsday. Is that Tony Stark under the mask?
payoff: Watch Fantastic Four: First Steps if you want to know Reed and his team before Doomsday.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Downey is back for Doomsday. Is that Tony Stark under the mask?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Disney announced him as Doctor Doom. A Tony Stark connection is still unconfirmed.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: So if you want one movie to understand the matchup, start with the other side.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doom rules Latveria. He combines sorcery and technology, and he's Reed Richards' rival.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Reed leads the Fantastic Four. First Steps introduces that team in the MCU.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: You can go into Doomsday cold. The earlier movie is optional, not homework.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Watch Fantastic Four: First Steps if you want to know Reed and his team before Doomsday.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Then read Doom's comics for more of the character. They aren't confirmed film spoilers.
